sources.entry: Saleor - GraphQL native, API-only platform for scalable composable e-commerce storefront. (Demo, Source Code) BSD-3-Clause Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: Saleor is an open-source, GraphQL-only, API-first headless e-commerce platform for building composable commerce backends.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Saleor as a GraphQL-native, API-only commerce backend where the API is the only way to interact with, configure, or extend the system. Features listed include multi-channel pricing and currencies, multi-warehouse stock, a product catalog with a flexible content model, orders with split payments and returns, a promotion engine (sales, vouchers, cart rules, gift cards), multi-gateway payment orchestration, translations, and a CMS for product and marketing content. Extensibility is handled through webhooks, attributes, metadata, apps, subscription queries, and dashboard iframes rather than plugins. The dashboard and storefront are separate repositories, and the README points to a saleor-platform project for running the API, storefront, and dashboard together locally.
use_cases: build a headless online store backend
manage product catalog and promotions via API
extend commerce backend with webhooks and apps
how_to_run: Run the full local stack with the saleor-platform project (see its repository for instructions)
For local development without Docker, follow the Contributing Guide
Alternatively, register for Saleor Cloud via the CLI: npm i -g @saleor/cli
notable: GraphQL-only API with no REST or plugin monolith
Per-channel control of pricing, currency, and stock
Apps extend the dashboard via iframe using any web stack
Decoupled dashboard, storefront, and platform repositories
caveats: The main branch is a development version and may be unstable; use 3.x releases for production
Service-oriented architecture is described as more complex than traditional monolithic platforms for small single-developer projects
Dashboard and storefront live in separate repositories and must be set up separately
